description: This file defines the CommentDefaultFormatter class for rendering comments in Drupal, including methods for view rendering, settings, and dependencies.

classes.name: CommentDefaultFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal formatter class for displaying comments with configurable view modes and pagination.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the comment formatter, including view mode and pager ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies like view builder, storage, current user, route match, and display repository.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for comments, including comment list and form, based on entity and user permissions.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Provides a form for configuring view mode and pager ID settings.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of current formatter settings for display.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies related to display modes and comment types.

methods.name: getViewModes
methods.description: Retrieves available view modes for the comment bundle.
